== Biography ==
George was born in 1844.  He was the son of [[Glasgow-657|John Glasgow]] and [[Leamer-31|Sarah Leamer]].  He passed away in 1921, and was buried at Pleasant Hill United Methodist Church Cemetery, Glasgow, Cambria County, Pennsylvania.<ref>[https://secure.findagrave.com/cgi-bin/fg.cgi?page=gr&GRid=29365961 Find A Grave Memorial# 29365961]</ref>

=== Obituary ===
George L. Glasgow, one of Cambria County’s most prominent citizens and postmaster at Glasgow for years, died at home on February 22, 1921. A native of Glasgow and in the merchandise business under the name of Glasgow and Troxell; and became the first postmaster at DuBois. He returned to Glasgow in 1876 for business and was appointed Postmaster, filling the position until 1919. He is survived by his wife, Julia, and two daughters, Mrs. C. J. Troxell and Mrs. Henry L. Canon, both of Glasgow, and a son Dr. Ellis Glasgow. The funeral will be from the home. Burial will be in the Pleasant Hill Cemetery, <ref>''Altoona Mirror'', Altoona, Penna., February 22, 1921.</ref>
